summary: An excerpt from a novel (labeled 'Book 1 — part 124') in which the narrator, Marcus, walks with Ange after school, quoting a passage from a book about 'mad' people that she finds delightful. Their walk is interrupted by Van (Vanessa), Marcus's former close friend, who seems shaken to see them together. Marcus explains that Van and he used to be best friends with Jose-Luis and Darryl through ARG play, and that they drifted apart after Van objected to the Xnet and worried about getting into trouble.
one_line: Marcus walks home with Ange, quoting a 'mad ones' passage, when former best friend Van appears and their past falling-out over the Xnet surfaces.
key_facts: The narrator Marcus quotes a passage describing 'the mad ones' who burn 'like fabulous yellow roman candles' and reads the word 'dingledodies' aloud to Ange.
Ange asks 'Wow, dingledodies! I love it! Is it all like this?' after reading the passage herself.
Marcus and Ange walk toward the bus-stop with their arms around each other's waists and shoulders.
Marcus says the walk made him 'forget my troubles for a little while.'
Van (Vanessa) calls out 'Marcus?' as they walk, and Marcus notes he had subconsciously expected her to appear.
Marcus had not spoken to Van in weeks, and those weeks 'felt like months'; they used to talk every day.
Marcus says he was suddenly embarrassed to be seen with another girl and tells Van he came out to get Ange.
Ange asks Marcus whether Van was his girlfriend; Marcus replies 'No! No way! We were just friends.'
Marcus says he, Van, Jose-Luis and Darryl were arrested together and used to play ARG together as best friends.
Marcus says Van 'didn't like the Xnet' and thought they would get into trouble and that he would get other people into trouble.
Marcus says he felt Van was walking behind them listening, and when he finally looked over his shoulder, Van was not there.
